system.biography:
Witch - Full Hex — Build Guide

Core Rulebook v3 Alpha 3, Appendix C. This Hero is built at Level 1 with no Ancestry — pick one, rename the Hero, and adjust anything you like.

Bought with the Starting Pack's silver: Light Armor (50s).

Stats at Level 10

MIT 4 · DEX 5 · AWR 7 · RSN 6 · PRS 4 · LUK 5

Perks by Level

  • 1st: Athame, Familiar (already on this sheet)
  • 3rd: Mesmer
  • 5th: Secret of Mana
  • 7th: Quality Assurance
  • 9th: Vehement Magic

Spells

Burn, Charm, Fear, Hold; get Dispel, Enflesh, Fade, and Levitate later

Leather, hide, padded.

Equipping Armor

Equipping or unequipping Armor requires a Scene (10 minutes) to complete.

Wouldst thou like to live deliciously?

—Robert Eggers, The VVitch

Witches are mediaries of magical secrets. One may become a witch through the whispers of a familiar or the favor of a being from beyond.

Iconic Witches

  • Dr. Facilier, The Princess and the Frog
  • Sabrina Spellman, Sabrina the Teenage Witch
  • The Morrigan, Celtic mythology
  • Yubaba, Spirited Away

Playing Witch

The witch is a debuffer focused on Casting Spells to stack detriments. Stick to the shadows and pile on Statuses through Hex.

Action: Cast
Move: Backline
Starting Pack: Fortune Teller or Mage
Key Stat: Awareness
Complexity: ★★★☆☆
Training: Craft, Mysticism

levelFeatures.name: Occultist
levelFeatures.description:
You gain a Perk with the Trained: Mysticism Prerequisite, and you can Cast Spells using Mysticism.

Spells: You learn 4 Spells. You learn 1 other Spell every 2 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (4 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (2 + your Level).

levelFeatures.name: Hex
levelFeatures.description: When you affect Enemies with the effect of a Spell, you can hex one of the Targeted Enemies. Doing so causes the effect to be continual (p. 91) until you hex a new Target.

levelFeatures.name: Widdershins (1)
levelFeatures.description: Your damage from Spell effects and your effective Level for the purpose of Spell effects are both increased by 1 against your hexed Target, and increased 1 more every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Perk
levelFeatures.description: Choose a new Perk. You must meet the prerequisites to take it, unless the Perk is granted through a Class Feature.

levelFeatures.name: Grudge Bearer (+1)
levelFeatures.description:
The number of Spells you can cause to be continual on the Target with your Hex Feature increases by 1 now and every 4 Levels hereafter.

Further, if you hex a new Target while you have an Enemy hexed, the new Target is affected by the previous Spells.

levelFeatures.description: Once per Action when you deal damage to an Enemy within Far of your hexed Target, the hexed Target also takes the damage.

system.description: You can conduct a Ritual (p. 10) with a Dagger, making it your athame until you conduct this ritual again. Your athame is a Relic with the Loyalty Power, and it can be used as a Trinket.

You can conduct a Ritual (p. 10) to conjure a familiar that you control with your Action or by skipping your Move. The familiar can be any Small Being with HD: 1. It uses your Cast Skill for Checks, and you can Cast Spells from the familiar as if it were originating from you.

The familiar is banished when it drops to 0 HP or if you conduct this Ritual again to create another familiar.
If the Target isn't immune to Fire, they are Burning (Cd4, or until it is doused). This Burning Status does not require Focus.
system.crit: The Cd4 instead starts at a Cd6.

system.description: Enthrallment keeps the Target Charmed for the duration, ending early if it takes damage or if you Cast this Spell again.

hitMacro.label: Charm

system.description: The Target is Frightened of another visible Target you choose for the duration, ending early if you Cast this Spell again.

hitMacro.label: Fear

system.description:
The Target is Paralyzed for the duration if its HD or Level is equal to or lower than your Level. You can spend Mana to increase your Level for the purposes of this casting by 1 per Mana spent to do so.

If the Target is an Object, it becomes secured and effectively locked if it is a door, chest, or other means of preventing entry. You must pass a Cast Check any time an attempt is made to manipulate the secured Object to maintain the Focus.
